content: 1. Suvorexant is not recommended for use with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors due to potential drug interactions. 2. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of tadalafil by inhibiting its metabolism through hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 enzymes. Tadalafil should be stopped at least 24 hours before initiating a protease inhibitor (PI) and restarted 7 days after PI initiation at a dose of 20 mg once daily, with a gradual increase to 40 mg once daily based on tolerability. 3. Nelfinavir affects the metabolism of tamoxifen by inhibiting CYP3A4, reducing its conversion to the active metabolite N-desmethyl tamoxifen. Alternate drugs should be considered. 4. Nelfinavir increases the levels of tamsulosin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 5. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of tazemetostat by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 6. Tepotinib increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. If co-administration is unavoidable, reduce the dosage of the P-gp substrate as recommended in its product labeling. 7. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of tiagabine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 8. Nelfinavir increases the levels of tofacitinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Reduce the tofacitinib dose to 5 mg once daily when co-administered with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors. 9. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of tolvaptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 10. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of topotecan by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use an alternative drug. For oral topotecan, avoid concomitant use of P-gp inhibitors. For IV topotecan, the interaction may be less severe but still clinically significant. 11. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of trabectedin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor must be used, administer it one week after trabectedin infusion and discontinue it the day before the next trabectedin infusion. 12. Tucatinib increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid concomitant use with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious toxicities. If unavoidable, reduce the CYP3A substrate dose according to product labeling. 13. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of ubrogepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 14. Nelfinavir increases the levels of vemurafenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 15. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of venetoclax by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. If a P-gp inhibitor must be used, reduce the venetoclax dose by at least 50% and monitor closely for signs of venetoclax toxicities. 16. Nelfinavir increases the levels of vilazodone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. If intolerable adverse effects occur with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, reduce the daily dose to 20 mg. 17. Vonoprazan decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 18. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of vorapaxar by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 19. Voriconazole increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 20. Nelfinavir and abacavir both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor. 21. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of abemaciclib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors increase plasma levels of abemaciclib and its metabolites, requiring dose reduction. If the strong CYP3A4 inhibitor is discontinued, increase abemaciclib to the dose prior to initiating the inhibitor. 22. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of acarbose through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Use caution and monitor. New-onset or exacerbation of diabetes mellitus and hyperglycemia have been reported with protease inhibitors. 23. Nelfinavir decreases the effects of albiglutide due to insulin resistance associated with protease inhibitors. Use caution and monitor. 24. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of almotriptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 25. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of alprazolam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 26. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of amitriptyline by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 27. Amobarbital decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 28. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of apalutamide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction may be needed based on tolerability. 29. Aprepitant increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, and nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of aprepitant. Use caution and monitor. 30. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of aripiprazole by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 31. Armodafinil decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 32. Artemether/lumefantrine decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir, while nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of artemether/lumefantrine. Use caution and monitor. 33. Atazanavir increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor. 34. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of atogepant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. The recommended atogepant dosage is 10 mg once daily when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 35. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of atorvastatin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Limit atorvastatin dose to 40 mg/day. Atorvastatin also increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 36. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of bazedoxifene/conjugated estrogens by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 37. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of benzhydrocodone/acetaminophen by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase hydrocodone plasma concentrations, potentially causing fatal respiratory depression. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 38. Berotralstat increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Monitor or titrate the P-gp substrate dose if co-administered. 39. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of betrixaban by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Decrease the betrixaban dose to 80 mg once, then 40 mg daily if co-administered with a P-gp inhibitor. 40. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of bexarotene by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 41. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of bortezomib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 42. Bosutinib increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 43. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of brentuximab vedotin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor patients for adverse reactions. 44. Nelfinavir increases the levels of bromocriptine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 45. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of budesonide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 46. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of buprenorphine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely due to potential increased toxicity. 47. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of buprenorphine buccal and subdermal implant formulations. Monitor patients for signs of overmedication. Implant removal may be necessary if dose adjustments are not feasible. 48. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of buprenorphine long-acting injection by inhibiting CYP2E1 metabolism. Monitor plasma levels to ensure adequacy and adjust therapy as needed. 49. Nelfinavir increases the levels of bupropion but decreases the levels of its active metabolites. Use caution and monitor. 50. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of buspirone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 51. Butabarbital decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 52. Butalbital decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 53. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of cabazitaxel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration due to potential increased toxicity. 54. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of calcifediol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor serum vitamin D levels and adjust calcifediol dose as needed. 55. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of cannabidiol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Cannabidiol also increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 56. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of capmatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 57. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of carbamazepine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor plasma levels when used concomitantly. 58. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of cariprazine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction is required when co-administered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 59. Cenobamate decreases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Cenobamate also increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 60. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of ceritinib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 61. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of chlordiazepoxide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Consider alternatives if available, and lower benzodiazepine doses if necessary. 62. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of ciclesonide inhaled by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for increased risk of Cushing's syndrome or adrenal suppression. 63. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of cilostazol by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 64. Cimetidine increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by increasing gastric pH. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Use caution and monitor. 65. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of cinacalcet by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 66. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of citalopram by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for potential increased toxicity. 67. Clarithromycin increases the levels and effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor. 68. Nelfinavir increases the levels and effects of clomipramine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 69. Nelfinavir increases the levels of clonazepam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor.
